steps.content: [Town center]
<color=#fb9259>Leave... Leave...</color>

The eerie whispers still linger near your ears, yet the townsfolk seem unaware of any disturbance. Your investigation so far suggests they are indeed just ordinary immigrants, drawn here by simple dreams. They revere and trust Vautour Bleu, blissfully awaiting the day to move to DisCity.
It's mid-afternoon while the diner is already closing for the day. Liam stretches up on his tiptoes to help hang the Closed sign on the door.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Time for a clock-out shot! Alba, look over here—snap, snap!
Though exhausted from a day's work, Alba musters the energy to humor Liam, striking a few poses for his toy camera.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Miss Vautour Bleu says I can get a real camera in DisCity. When we're there, I'll take your picture, Alba! It'll be just as beautiful as the one of my Mom!

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: Oh my, then I must sign up for a beauty pageant with that photo!

steps.speaker: Juan
steps.content: Oh crap, that pageant my ass. It's all about the prize money, ain't it?

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: Shut it, Juan. It's an honor! You think everyone's like you? Get drunk and yack at Miss Vautour Bleu's door, "Hypercube is my true love! I'mma make tons of Hypercubes in DisCity!" Eww.

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Oh... How many cameras can I buy with one Hypercube?

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Mmm... I'm not quite sure... but I guess you can buy a whole sack of bread with one Hypercube!

Hypercubes are a strictly regulated resource in DisCity; even Vautour Bleu can't sneak any out to satisfy their curiosity. The group's noisy banter leads nowhere as they while away the last moments before sunset. However, none of them notices the strange voice murmuring in the shadows.
<color=#fb9259>Beware... You must beware...</color>
The whisper creeps close and becomes more distinct. You glance around but see nothing. Primrose, however, seems to notice your unusual behavior.

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Are you looking for something?

options: Did you hear any strange noise?

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Noise? Hmm... Maybe it's the sound of the caravan coming back?
No. It sounded more like... someone talking.

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Usually everyone's heading home around now. Maybe you're overhearing someone grumbling about their day?
Primrose turns back to say something more, but the cloaked figure she was talking to is already gone.
[Dark alley]
<color=#fb9259>Must tell them...</color>
<color=#fb9259>I'm... going to...</color>

Following the whispers, you slip away from the crowds and head deeper into the town. Here, the ever-present datura flowers are surprisingly nowhere to be seen. The walls bear marks of once-lush vines, now only left with withered branches and sparse yellow leaves.
It's as if an invisible barrier is blocking out the sunlight, casting only layer upon layer of oppressive shadows over everything.
The whispers seems to creep close from all sides.
<color=#fb9259>Désir... destroy...</color>
<color=#fb9259>I... destroy...</color>
The voices hover in the air, plucking at your nerves like unseen fingers. Yet, the dark alley stretching ahead remains eerily empty.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is there anything I can help you with?
The moment the words leave your lips, the whispers cease entirely. A complete silence engulfs the alley, thick and suffocating.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can you hear me?

You take another cautious step forward. Only silence responds. Save for the soft crunch of moss beneath your boots, you only catch faint sounds of Alba and the others in the distance as the town continues its leisure afternoon.
Was it all in your head? You cast one last glance into the depths of the shadows. Seeing nothing, you make to leave...
Plop. A datura flower withers and drops at your feet all of a sudden.
At the same moment, an icy touch crawls up your shoulder. In the shadows something slowly swells and flows, trying to envelop you within its mass.
As the surrounding vegetation withers rapidly, the air grows heavy, filled again with elusive whispers.
A silhouette gradually takes shape before you. There's no mistaking it, what follows is the familiar feeling of...
Mania!
